room_rent.note: Room category and rent limits are specified in the policy schedule; proportional deduction applies if higher room availed. Exact category not stated in wording.

icu.note: ICU/CCU/HDU charges covered; specific limits defined in policy schedule, not in wording document.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional co-pay (3.3.8) gives premium discount. Co-pay also triggered if First Notification (3.3.6) or Preferred Provider Network (3.3.7) conditions are breached.

sub_limits.note: Wording allows sub-limits to be specified in the Schedule; no specific disease sub-limits stated in the wording itself. Underwriting conditions may apply sub-limits.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Optional Super Top-up (3.3.9) adds an aggregate deductible as specified in schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period (Excl03). Can be waived via optional benefit 3.3.16.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as per schedule; definition uses 36-month look-back. Exact waiting period confirmed in schedule.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific illness waiting period up to 36 months per Excl02. Can be reduced via optional benefits 3.3.12 (Comprehensive) or 3.3.13 (Essential).

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy for in-patient only is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus (3.3.3) is an optional basic benefit option. Rate and maximum cap specified in schedule. No claim impact on accrual.

restoration.display: Optional; unlimited or once, related/unrelated per Schedule
restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured (3.3.2) is optional. Conditions (related or related+unrelated) and number of restorations specified in schedule. Does not trigger on first claim of year.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered (3.2.4); exact number of days specified in policy schedule.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered (3.2.4); exact number of days specified in policy schedule.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered (3.2.3); list available at acko.com/gi.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered (3.2.7) if treatment continues for at least 3 consecutive days; reimbursement basis only.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered (3.2.10) up to sum insured; OPD AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor in-patient hospitalisation expenses covered (3.2.8) up to insured's sum insured; pre/post-hosp of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered (3.2.5) at reasonable and customary charges; no fixed rupee cap stated in wording.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed in 3.2.11 covered for in-patient/day care; no sub-limit stated in wording.

consumables.note: Non-payable/consumable expenses (Annexure 1) excluded by default; covered if optional benefit 3.3.10 (Waiver of non-payable expenses) is opted.

global_cover.note: Worldwide in-patient hospitalisation (3.3.1) available as optional basic benefit option; base policy covers India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), claims cannot be contested except for fraud.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for renewal and quarterly/half-yearly/annual instalments; 15 days for monthly instalments.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only; not applicable on renewals or porting.

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI guidelines (Section 5.2.13).

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, substance abuse/cancer in tobacco users, dental, external prosthetics, war/nuclear/bio/chem

optional_riders.display: Restore SI, Cumulative Bonus, NCB SI, Super Top-up, Worldwide cover, Waiver of non-payables, OPD cover, Daily Hospital Cash, Accidental Death/Disability, Co-pay discount
